Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
thomas stellmach <soch...@sp.zrz.tu-berlin.de> writes:

>Two questions ( propably covered before, but my playgroup
>wants hardcopied proof):

>Blood Doll: Are multiple blood dolls playable on one vampire
>and are they cumulative ? (IMO: yes and yes)

Yes and Yes.

>Amaranth: Playable by a minion being burned ? ( card text
>says only "...going to torpor" but, hmmm...)

No. It has errata on it that it cannot be used by a vampire (or minion)
who is burned in combat (of course, Allies can't use it anyhow).

Similar errata exists for Pulled Fangs and Taste of Vitae.
